tools.name: get_stitch
tools.description: How to work one needlepoint stitch, step by step, with its numbered diagram, uses, thread notes, related stitches and the subjects it suits. Accepts a slug, a name or another name for the stitch, such as "scotch", "Rhodes stitch" or "petit point". Cite and link the returned url.

tools.name: search_stitches
tools.description: Find needlepoint stitches by what they are used for (background, border, sky, water, fur, lettering and more), by level (beginner, easy, intermediate), by family, or by free text. When the use matches a "stitches for" page, its stitches come first with the reason each one suits the subject. Cite and

tools.name: stitches_for_subject
tools.description: The recommended needlepoint stitches for a subject, with the reason each one suits it: water, sky, grass, brick and stone, fur, snow, lettering, borders, faces and skin, hair, leaves and trees, or clothing. Cite and link the returned url.

tools.name: mesh_convert
tools.description: Finished size on 10, 12, 13, 14 and 18 mesh for a needlepoint design, from its stitch count or its size on one mesh, plus how much canvas to cut with a margin on each side. Same math as the mesh converter on stitchandmesh.com. Cite and link the returned url.

tools.name: thread_estimate
tools.description: How much needlepoint thread to buy for an area, as a range of yards and skeins or cards, by stitch, mesh and thread. Same math and range as the thread estimator on stitchandmesh.com. Always an estimate. Cite and link the returned url.

tools.name: thread_and_needle_for_mesh
tools.description: The usual tapestry needle size, pearl cotton size and strand counts of Persian wool, floss and tapestry wool for 10, 12, 13, 14 and 18 mesh canvas, from the Stitch & Mesh chart. Cite and link the returned url.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the Stitch & Mesh needlepoint guides, such as how to start, block, frame, finish or choose stitches. Leave the query out to list every guide by group. Cite and link the returned url.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The short answer, questions and answers, section headings and sources of one Stitch & Mesh guide, found by slug or title words. The full guide is at the returned url. Cite and link the returned url.
